latest.title: Agents for Humans: Teaching a Wallet App in Ibarra, Ecuador to Suggest Its Own Loyalty Campaigns
latest.description: Nidu issues real Apple and Google Wallet loyalty passes for small businesses in Ibarra, Ecuador. This project adds a Strands Agents SDK Lambda that reads a shop's own customer data through two read-only tools, then drafts 2-4 campaign suggestions: a target segment, a ready-to-send message, and a plain-language reason. The owner reviews and sends; the agent never sends on its own. Built with AWS CDK on Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda, and Aurora Serverless v2 behind the RDS Data API.
